design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark/light dual-theme site with a clear hero, consistent nav across breakpoints, visible keyboard focus, and distinct CTA styling. Main defects are the floating 'Voice Agent' widget overlapping content (it obscures the Reliability & Fact Check card on desktop and the '24/7' stat on small mobile), some low-contrast secondary text in light mode, and one card clipped at the right viewport edge.
strengths: Strong visual hierarchy: large gradient hero headline ('AI Testing & Integration. Building Trust.'), clear badge, stat block, and two distinct CTAs (filled 'Live Feed' vs outlined 'AI Lab')
Consistent navigation across desktop and mobile: same items (Feed, Explore, Tools, Challenge, Digest, Break it) preserved in the mobile drawer, with adequate tap-target spacing
Visible, high-contrast focus ring on the focused 'Explore' nav item in ui-keyboard-focus, demonstrating keyboard accessibility support
Theme toggle works with an appropriate moon icon state in light mode, and both themes keep consistent layout, branding, and component styling
Tool cards use consistent structure (colored icon, title, description, colored action link: Explore/Scan/Verify/Check) aiding predictability
Clear status signaling in the AI Test Result panel (PASS badge, per-check Passed/Warning with color icons)
issues: The floating 'Voice Agent' widget and adjacent robot button overlap and obscure content: on desktop they cover the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card text and 'Check →' link; on small mobile they cover the '24/7 AUTO-UPDATED' stat

In light theme, low-contrast secondary text: 'ARTICLES TODAY' / 'RSS SOURCES' / 'AUTO-UPDATED' labels and card descriptions appear washed out on the light background; orange 'Check →' link on light background is weak
The fourth tool card ('Reliability & Fact Check') is clipped at the right viewport edge on desktop, cutting off text ('unsupported AI cla...')
